D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Zoe Lofgren leads by 46.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 121,638 votes; a one point swing is about 1,310 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +39.6 and D +52.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$714K cash against $3K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
